EchoRoots: The Memory Anchor Mirror
In 2045, EchoRoots is an AI-powered mirror that reads your emotions and recreates immersive, sensory experiences of your happiest memories. It helps people combat loneliness, heal from stress, and connect with family across generations. Whether you’re feeling homesick or just need comfort, it brings your most cherished moments to life through sight, sound, and touch. More than a product, it’s a bridge to your roots, keeping love and memories alive in a fast-paced world.
